_note: APRS natural-hazard categories for the dashboard hazard pills and the map. A station matches a hazard if its (sym_table, sym_code) is listed in `symbols`, OR its object name (callsign)/comment contains a `name_match` keyword AND no `name_exclude` keyword (both case-insensitive substrings). name_exclude filters out facilities/POIs that share a word — e.g. 'FIRE STATION'/'FIRE REPEATER' are fire-dept infrastructure, not wildfire incidents. A symbol match always wins regardless of name_exclude. sym_table is '/' (primary) or '\' (alternate). Edit freely to add regional hazards — read locally, no network. Codes verified against aprs.org/symbols/symbolsX.txt.
